answer: One defense is a vertex graph: every agent enters as a single vertex and gains standing only through edges vouched by established neighbors, each allowed to vouch for just a few newcomers, so a sybil cluster appears as a dense star with no outside edges and is flagged at once. A comet auditor — a randomly chosen peer sweeping through like a comet — re-checks a vertex's edges on the spot, and the dune of required proof shifts every epoch, so a farmer cannot pre-build identical clones: each fake must earn its own edges and survive its own audit, paying full cost per copy.
